en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a partly collapsed stone gateway or arch standing alone in a rough, grassy landscape. The structure is a substantial ruin with large rectangular blocks and an arched opening, identified in the caption as the gate of the Temple of Lysimachus at Ephesus. There is printed text along the bottom margin in French and a small circular stamp-like mark and website watermark.
